        print(f"{'='*80}")
        continue
    
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"PDF: {pdf_path}")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
    
    try:
        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
            print(f"Total pages: {len(pdf.pages)}\n")
            
            # Extract text from first 3 pages
            extracted_text = ""
            for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages[:3]):
                text = page.extract_text()
                extracted_text += text + "\n"
                print(f"--- PAGE {i+1} ---")
                print(text)
                print()
            
            # Check for sensitive information
            print(f"\n{'='*80}")
            print("SENSITIVITY CHECK RESULTS:")
            print(f"{'='*80}\n")
            
            import re
            
            found_sensitive = False
            
            # Check author names
            print("Author Names:")
            for name in sensitive_patterns['author_names']:
                if name.lower() in extracted_text.lower():
                    print(f"  [FOUND] {name}")
                    found_sensitive = True
            if not found_sensitive or all(name.lower() not in extracted_text.lower() for name in sensitive_patterns['author_names']):

                    print(f"  [REDACTED] All author names")
            
            # Check emails
            print("\nEmail Addresses:")
            for email in sensitive_patterns['emails']:
                if email.lower() in extracted_text.lower():
                    print(f"  [FOUND] {email}")
                    found_sensitive = True
            if not any(email.lower() in extracted_text.lower() for email in sensitive_patterns['emails']):
                print(f"  [REDACTED] All specific emails")
            
            # Check institutions
            print("\nInstitutions:")
            for inst in sensitive_patterns['institutions']:
                if inst.lower() in extracted_text.lower():
                    print(f"  [FOUND] {inst}")
                    found_sensitive = True
            if not any(inst.lower() in extracted_text.lower() for inst in sensitive_patterns['institutions']):
                print(f"  [REDACTED] All institutions")
            
            # Check arXiv IDs
            print("\narXiv IDs (format YYMM.NNNNN):")
            arxiv_matches = re.findall(sensitive_patterns['arxiv'], extracted_text)
            if arxiv_matches:
                for match in set(arxiv_matches):
                    print(f"  [FOUND] {match}")
                    found_sensitive = True
            else:
                print(f"  [REDACTED] No arXiv IDs found")
            
            # Check GitHub URLs
            print("\nGitHub URLs:")
            if 'github.com' in extracted_text.lower():
                github_matches = re.findall(r'github\.com/[\w\-/]*', extracted_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                for match in set(github_matches):
                    print(f"  [FOUND] {match}")
                    found_sensitive = True
            else:
                print(f"  [REDACTED] No GitHub URLs found")
            
            if not found_sensitive:
                print("\n✓ No sensitive information detected in first 3 pages!")
            else:
                print("\n⚠ WARNING: Sensitive information detected!")
                
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error processing {pdf_path}: {str(e)}")
